The magnitude of the cross product is

\[
\|\mathbf a \times \mathbf b\|
= \sqrt{3^2+2^2+6^2}
= \sqrt{49}
= 7.
\]

Also,

\[
\|\mathbf a \times \mathbf b\|=\|\mathbf a\|\|\mathbf b\|\sin\theta
=2\cdot 7\sin\theta=14\sin\theta.
\]

Thus

\[
14\sin\theta=7 \implies \sin\theta=\frac12.
\]

So the possible angles are \(30^\circ\) and \(150^\circ\). The smallest possible angle is

\[
\boxed{30}
\]
